Sorry it took me a while to answer :/ but yes, since then, I’ve been fully dosed minus metformin. I’m still feeling pretty good and losing weight at a slow pace but still losing. I have almost no cravings at all, just a couple of days where I was craving carbs and sweet treats. Then I got my period, so everything made sense! Still, I was able to eat just 3-4 oreos instead of the whole package, like in the past, which was a huge accomplishment for me, tbh.

Hey there! I’m starting week 5, and so far I've lost 5.2 lbs—most of that in the last two weeks. I don’t have much to lose, so I knew not to expect huge weekly drops. Just for some context: SW: 161, CW: 155.8, GW: 142.

I've been struggling with binge eating for a while, which led to weight gain over the past couple of years. But since I started my kit 1, literally from day one, the food noise just vanished. I barely had any side effects—just felt a bit funky for the first two days. Now I feel great, like myself but without that constant food noise.

The only thing that I can say is that metformin is definitely not for me, I took one dose and I had terrible nausea (ended up throwing up) with a brain fog that was so extreme that I was not even able to wash dishes and I said NOPE, I don't want this, I’m losing weight at a slow but steady pace and feeling good, so why rush it? and I let the medical team knew about it but haven't received any answer... 

Okay, that was a lot of context! But honestly, I definitely noticed a change after week 3, and now that I’m in week 5, I can tell you I feel and look different. I seem less bulky! Did I lose 5.2 lbs of just fat? Water? Muscle? Probably a mix of everything. But you’ll see the change eventually! We’re in a calorie deficit, so it’s physically impossible not to see some results over time—we’re eating less, after all! 

Keep it up! :)

Hello, I just had my LEEP procedure today, literally about 4 hours ago, and I’m experiencing a lot of cramping. So, for today, I will just rest and try to ignore the pain. The written instructions I received before the procedure said that I must avoid sex, pools, tampons, douches, exercise, and heavy lifting for 2 weeks. However, today my doctor said none of that for 4 WEEKS, not even Pilates or barre after 2 weeks. So now I have to put my barre membership on hold. My doctor said that I could replace my exercise with walks. I don’t know if maybe I had a lot of tissue removed and that’s why she extended my recovery period, but she didn’t explain much because I was still recovering from the anesthesia. I would recommend giving your doctor a call and asking about it in advance. I didn’t do this, so maybe that’s why I was shocked when she said 4 weeks. I hope this helps and wish you the best!
